articles.full_text:
Telangana Agriculture and Marketing Minister Tummala Nageswara Rao. File.
| Photo Credit: NAGARA GOPAL
HYDERABAD
Drought conditions are prevailing across 315 out of 621 mandals in the Telangana and different sections are awaiting relief measures from the Centre, Minister for Agriculture Tummala Nageswara Rao has said. He has requested the Centre to provide wage employment work to farmworkers and water conservation works widely under the VB-G RAM G programme.
The Minister stated that the ‘khet bachao abhiyan’ would be implemented in the State from October 22 to 30 with the national agricultural institutions and universities. During a virtual meeting chaired by the Union Agriculture Minister, he sought additional budgetary allocation for micro irrigation implements and inter-cropping seed.
Reiterating the request for 100% procurement of maize, jowar and other major crops, Mr. Rao suggested lifting of the 25% cap on the procurement of such crops under the minimum support price-price support scheme operations. He further wanted the Centre to rationalise the prices of fertilizers and subsidies.
The Minister stated that such measures were necessary in the wake of the El Nino impact on the State as they would help farmers control the loss to some extent. He felt that farmers would adapt to the crop pattern changes only if their existing crops’ produce was procured entirely at MSP.

articles.full_text:
Karnataka weather is going to enter another wet week as the northeast monsoon is causing rain across the state, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) warning of very heavy rainfall in the South Interior districts today, October 18. A thunderstorm, lightning and squall warning has also been issued for all three sub-divisions, which means gusty winds are likely along with the showers.
For today, the IMD expects scattered light to moderate rain with thunderstorms and strong winds across the state, while isolated places in the South Interior may see heavy to very heavy rain.
This sub-division, which includes Bengaluru, Mysuru, Kodagu and Chamarajanagar, has been placed under an orange alert for the day, the highest level of warning in the state's forecast this week. Rainfall activity is expected to remain low over the Kalyana Karnataka region, though sunny and cloudy spells will alternate in several places.
The South Interior is likely to stay under pressure well beyond today. The IMD has forecast heavy rain with thunderstorm, lightning and squalls from October 19 to 21, and heavy rain is expected to continue from October 22 to 24.
Residents in low-lying areas and those who commute through waterlogging-prone stretches may need to plan around the weather through the week.
Coastal Karnataka is in a different phase. Thunderstorm and lightning activity is expected on October 18 and 19, followed by heavy rain along with thunderstorms, lightning and squalls on October 20 and 21. Heavy rain is likely to continue on October 22, after which the IMD has issued no warning for October 23 and 24.
North Interior Karnataka weather will see thunderstorm and lightning activity which is likely from October 18 to 21, but no warning has been issued for October 22 to 24. Alongside the rain, morning mist and fog are likely to cover several parts of the state during early hours, which could reduce visibility for morning commuters.

articles.title: AIIMS doctors identify ‘Red Alert Zone’ to reduce risks in complex cancer surgery - The Economic Times
articles.search_term: ("heat advisory" OR "heat action plan" OR "heat alert" OR "IMD warning" OR "IMD alert" OR "red alert" OR "orange alert" OR "yellow alert" OR "NDMA advisory" OR "cooling shelter" OR "relief measures" OR "heat compensation" OR "severe weather warning") Assam
articles.full_text:
Dr M D Ray, professor in the Department of Surgical Oncology at Dr BRA-IRCH, AIIMS Delhi, along with his team identified an area below the uterine vessels as the "Red Alert Zone" or "Ray's Zone", where the ureter, urinary bladder, pelvic nerves and important blood vessels lie in close proximity.

The concept emerged from a study of 255 radical or modified radical hysterectomies performed for cervical, endometrial and ovarian cancers.
After analysing the anatomy and causes of operative bleeding and injury, the surgical approach was modified in the later 105 cases.
The technique emphasises meticulous anatomical visualisation, magnification when required, individual vessel ligation and avoidance of excessive cautery near the pelvic ureter.
Researchers said careful dissection in Ray's Zone could help reduce blood loss and minimise ureteric, bladder and pelvic nerve injuries, thereby improving postoperative function and quality of life.
Dr Ray has also recently described another surgically important area, termed "Ray's Hepatocaval Triangle," relevant during liver mobilisation and dissection near the inferior vena cava and major hepatic venous structures.
The hepatocaval region is considered technically demanding because uncontrolled manipulation can result in major vascular injury and severe bleeding.
According to the surgical concept, defining this anatomical triangle provides surgeons with a clearer operative reference while handling the liver near major vessels.

Both anatomical concepts are based on a common principle -- identifying a potentially hazardous surgical area before entering it and performing controlled, anatomy-guided dissection.
The researchers said such anatomical mapping could improve surgical precision and help preserve vital structures during major oncological procedures.
In simple terms, Ray's Zone in the pelvis and Ray's Hepatocaval Triangle near the liver act as anatomical warning zones, reminding surgeons where maximum precision and caution are required.

Lithuania declares red alert and orders people to seek shelter — RMF24
On Sunday morning, October 18, 2026, Lithuania declared a red air alert in the central and northern parts of the country. Residents of the areas covered by the warning were ordered to move to shelters, RMF24 reports.
Alert in Lithuania
The red warning level was declared not across all of Lithuania, but in its central and northern parts. The instruction to move to shelters applied to residents of the areas where the air alert was declared.
More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel Telegram.
Yellow level in Latvia
At the same time, Latvia introduced a yellow warning level near its border with Lithuania. The Latvian side reported a possible threat related to an approaching drone.
According to Reuters, as cited by RMF24, at the time of publication no details were reported about the type of drone, its route, or other circumstances of the potential threat. The outlet also said it was awaiting further information.
